notes.name_pattern_scope: The original 47-object probe counted names containing nurbs/surf. Binary tag discovery finds 95 real tag-9/tag-10 records, including nested objects such as skin30.
notes.unsupported_variant: skin33, skin43, and skin56 set closed_v=true while storing a clamped/open-like V knot count. The converter deliberately leaves this variant unresolved rather than forcing a seam.

purpose: Golden-reference fixture for reverse engineering binary Softimage NURBS/surface HRC payloads. The manual Blender file is not committed; generate reference_manifest.json locally from the known-good conversion.
